spec.text: Image 1 is the approved couple; image 2 is the woman's casual model sheet. Create a FACE REFERENCE SHEET of the woman on the right of image 1: three large head-and-shoulders views of the SAME face side by side at the same scale - front view, three-quarter view, side profile - each head filling most of the canvas height. Copy her face from image 1 exactly: large round dark-brown eyes with bright white catchlights, short soft brown eyebrows, a small button nose, a small closed-mouth gentle smile, full rounded cheeks with soft pink blush, a soft rounded chin; half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands gathered at the back and loose lower waves (the back of the hair visible in the profile view). She wears the oatmeal knit sweater from image 2. Sculpted matte clay with painted gouache texture, soft even studio light, plain warm ivory background. No text, no labels, no extra people.
